title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Discover the unique rituals, mascots, and ceremonies that define the Pioneer experience at Wisconsin's first four-year institution.

cards.title: The Piper's Call
cards.subtitle: Opening Convocation and Commencement
cards.notes: Follow the lone bagpiper as they lead the faculty and student procession across campus during major academic ceremonies, a nod to the school's heritage.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial bagpipe-led march that marks the beginning and end of a student's journey at Carroll.
cards.evidence_claim: A wonderful tradition on my campus both on the first day before classes and again at graduation is to have a bagpiper majestically lead the students on to campus.
cards.source_title: The Siren Song of Bag Pipes Once Again Call Me Back to Carroll Land
cards.access_notes: Visible during public university ceremonies like Opening Convocation and Commencement.

cards.title: Pio Pete's Sideline Spirit
cards.subtitle: Official University Mascot
cards.notes: Look for the buckskin-clad pioneer mascot at athletic events and campus celebrations; he is a central figure in Carroll's 'Pioneer' identity.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Carroll University, representing the school's 'Pioneer' nickname at sports and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Pioneers know and love the familiar figure of Pio Pete... he appeared in parades, braved basketball courts.
cards.source_title: Who - and Where - is Polly Pioneer?
cards.access_notes: Appears at various public athletic events and university-wide celebrations.

cards.title: The Mystery of Polly Pioneer
cards.subtitle: Historical Secondary Mascot
cards.notes: Learn about Polly, the buckskin-wearing female mascot who appeared alongside Pete in the 1970s and returned as a 'human' mascot in 1997.
cards.short_summary: A historical secondary mascot whose legacy is celebrated through archival stories and occasional modern appearances.
cards.evidence_claim: Polly was often seen around campus hanging out with Pio Pete... this human version debuted in 1997.
cards.source_title: Who - and Where - is Polly Pioneer?
cards.access_notes: Legacy documented in university archives and F1RST magazine.

cards.title: Living the Ethos
cards.subtitle: Annual Values Reflection
cards.notes: Participate in this day-long event focused on respect, integrity, and stewardship, featuring workshops and a cultural market.
cards.short_summary: An annual university-wide event dedicated to exploring and practicing the Carroll University Ethos.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll University's 6th Annual Ethos Symposium was a day-long event that provided a space for reflection and fostering transformative learning experiences.
cards.source_title: BALANCING ACT: - Carroll Remains Financially Sound
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, staff, and the community.

cards.title: Ringing the Victory Bell
cards.subtitle: Commencement Tradition
cards.notes: Listen for the bell behind Old Main, which is traditionally rung to celebrate commencement and significant university milestones.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where a bell is rung to signal the completion of studies and other campus victories.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus walks and the victory bell will provide a reminiscent setting for the commencement... behind Old Main.
cards.access_notes: Located on the lawn behind Old Main; typically rung during graduation ceremonies.

cards.title: Founders Day Convocation
cards.subtitle: Celebrating University Origins
cards.notes: Attend the formal gathering that honors the university's 1846 charter and the individuals who established Wisconsin's first college.
cards.short_summary: An annual academic ceremony commemorating the founding of Carroll University.
cards.evidence_claim: The first Founders' Day Convocation is observed... Founders Day Convocation programs, 2000-present.
cards.access_notes: Held annually, typically in the Shattuck Music Center or Main Hall.

cards.title: Blessing of the Graduates
cards.subtitle: Baccalaureate Service
cards.notes: Join this multi-faith service where graduating seniors receive a formal blessing before their commencement ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A spiritual tradition held during commencement week to honor the journey of the graduating class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baccalaureate service honors Carroll's religious heritage and culminates with a special blessing for the Class of 2027.
cards.access_notes: Held in Shattuck Auditorium; open to graduates and their families.

cards.title: Pio4Life Cap Decorating
cards.subtitle: Commencement Creative Tradition
cards.notes: Express your personality by decorating your graduation cap for a chance to win prizes in this annual commencement contest.
cards.short_summary: A creative tradition where seniors decorate their mortarboards for the graduation ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: PIO4LIFE CAP CONTEST Show off your personality and your pioneer pride by decorating your cap for commencement!
cards.access_notes: Participation is open to all graduating seniors.

cards.title: Golden Pioneer Pinning
cards.subtitle: 50th Reunion Ceremony
cards.notes: Watch as alumni celebrating their 50th graduation anniversary are officially inducted as 'Golden Pioneers' during Homecoming weekend.
cards.short_summary: A ceremony honoring alumni who graduated 50 or more years ago.
cards.evidence_claim: 50th Reunion Dinner & Golden Pioneer Pinning Ceremony... Pioneers from the Class of 1976 will gather for this pinning ceremony.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Stackner Ballroom during Homecoming weekend.

cards.title: CUonGivingTuesday
cards.subtitle: Annual Day of Giving
cards.notes: Join the campus-wide effort to support student scholarships and programs during this high-energy annual fundraising tradition.
cards.short_summary: A modern tradition of community giving that supports the university's mission and students.
cards.evidence_claim: CUonGivingTuesday is the perfect way to kick off the giving season by supporting something meaningful—Carroll University students!
cards.access_notes: A digital and campus-wide event held annually in late November or early December.
